## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and contains no unrelated cleanup.
- [ ] Tests or documentation cover the changed contract where applicable.
- [ ] `PASS`, `FAIL`, `ABSTAIN`, and `ERROR` remain distinct where applicable.
- [ ] First observed divergence is not presented as root cause.
- [ ] Exact comparison and explicit tolerance remain separate where applicable.
- [ ] No secrets, checkpoints, generated data, caches, or private paths are included.
- [ ] Hosted CI is successful before merge.
